title: The Contracts Come Due
dialogue: Danika's report arrived without a cover note. That means the contents speak for themselves.
monologue: She sends cover notes when the findings are ambiguous. No cover note means the findings are not ambiguous.

narrative.text: Three of the seven highway contracts show evidence of systematic invoice inflation. The amounts are not trivial — approximately four million kroner across fourteen months of construction. The firms involved have corporate structures that trace, through two intermediaries, to a holding company with documented connections to Lucan Vael.
I can prosecute. The evidence is solid. The question is whether you want me to.

highway_corruption_brief.monologue: She asked whether I want her to prosecute. Not whether she should — she already knows she should. She is asking whether I will let her. That is a different question and she knows it.

choices.text: "Prosecute. Full investigation. The law applies to everyone."
"Recover the funds through a quiet audit settlement. No prosecution. The highway completes on schedule."
